description: Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection integration for the Projection object mapper: register your maps with services.AddMapper(...) and inject IMapper.

A simple, fast object-to-object mapper for .NET. Map entities to DTOs by convention or with a fluent API (CreateMap, ForMember, MapFrom, Ignore), with nested objects, collections, automatic type conversion, configuration validation and detailed errors. Maps are compiled with expression trees.

SkiaSharp-based image resizing for .NET. Provides a low-level ImageResizer (fit-in and fill-in/crop JPEG output) and a high-level ImageProcessorService that produces a main image and a thumbnail from a single stream.
Renders compiled Razor components to HTML with ASP.NET Core's HtmlRenderer for Regira.
HTML to PDF through headless Chromium with PuppeteerSharp: A4 with backgrounds, one browser reused across calls, scripts and network requests off by default, the sandbox on, and a render timeout.
Mail sending to any SMTP server via MailKit for Regira Office.
HTML to PDF conversion through the Chromium route of a Gotenberg server for Regira Office.
Word, Excel and PowerPoint to PDF conversion in-process using MiniPdf for Regira Office.
PDF operations for Regira Office: merge, split, page removal, text extraction and images to PDF using PdfPig, and page images using PDFtoImage (PDFium).
Test helpers for apps that use PulseSharp: a recording IPulse, ready-made handler contexts, and a test host with the real engine that waits until every handler is done. Works with any test framework.

HTTP-neutral entity operations for Regira entities: details, list, search, save, patch and delete as requests sent through IEntitySender, with the paging, refetch-after-save and DTO mapping the generated endpoints apply. Sekiwa licensing SDK for .NET: offline-verified, signed licences for desktop and server apps.
